name: SmartX REST Integration
description: Replace the SmartX browser-automation exporter (infra/aws/ec2/smartx-exporter, Playwright page-scrape) with a direct REST integration, and give SmartX the Orion parked-JWT token-management pattern. SmartX is a standards-compliant OIDC/OAuth2 stack (IdentityServer); a ROPC password grant works fully headless -> 2h Bearer JWT, so token refresh runs in a Lambda (no EC2, no browser). NOT an Orion replacement -- a parallel sibling pipeline tracking different clients. First data goal (Andrew): daily model value + holdings weights for each Opal model, pulled ~09:00 ET (SmartX settles the day's data by ~9 AM ET). JWT store + data colocated in opal-data-bd (SmartX feeds 49F/BD-domain work).
